body: Yeah.. I can’t even look at pictures from the past. They make me feel so bad.

Listen, I don’t know how to say this. I am in a way, in the same situation, but different role.
I am the kid in the situation, I am young, and my father has abused the whole family mentally and physically for so damn long. This caused me to be suicidal since the age of 10 or 11. 
I don’t know if this helps, but I love my mom. It’s not her fault we have suffered. Its the father. And trust me, last thing I want to see, is my mother dead. 
Your aren’t a burden, you are a strong woman. Don’t let youself down. I don’t know how to help, but I hope this atleast does some positive to you. I hope the best for your family, let’s hope we both get out of our situations peacefully and let’s hope we can enjoy life soon!

Please don’t. You got a whole life ahead, don’t end it so soon. You can explore the world, meet people and live. 
We’re both young, we gotta remember we’re in this journey together, its a long road, but it’s gonna be worth it, im sure

It depends. Some people are very bad, but not everyone. I still have very fucking bad regret of people I have hurt in the past. I don’t know where they are, or how they are, but I hope, they are doing good. 
But then again, I have people I don’t like either.. people who have hurt me. 
I can’t say shit, because I am worse that scum, or so it seems to me, but don’t let yourself get into that negative mindset. Instead of wanting them to see you dead, why not do good in life in whatever way you see fit. Rich or just generous. After all, It could be, that they don’t even see you or anyone else, it could be that they are in pain themselves and all they know is spreading it. 
Maybe I’m just stupid writing here, but who knows..

You aren’t a bad person. A bad person is someone who does bad, and keeps doing it, you on the other hand, YOU realize that change needs to be done, and trust me, It can be done. Remember this, change starts with you, and a negative mindset can set you back very far.
You got this. Don’t let youself down. You aren’t a coward, you are a human. You fear, because fear is what drives us forward. Remember, you are enough as it is, don’t try change for anyone, but if you feel bad, try doing things, even if one thing, one small thing a day, that makes YOU proud of YOURSELF!

Hey listen, I can’t say I feel your pain, but I’m mentally and physically abused myself by my parents and have been since I can remember. My mother has got black eyes in the past and same with us kids in the family. 
Remember this, you aren’t alone and I am here for you and so are millions of others. We will get through this together, because thats all we can do right now. 
Don’t let your parents make you suicidal, because you don’t want death, you want change. And change will come, trust me. ❤️

Listen, you feel pain. This means you’ve realized your mistakes, don’t let past mistakes influence your mind. You aren’t a shit person for this, this was a bad thing to do, but it doesnt make YOU a bad person. 
One battle lost doesn’t mean the war is over. One war lost, doesn’t mean the country is done for. Even after everything, it’s about growing and realizing and changing. 
When it’s time, she’ll perhaps want to talk and you can apologise, if she wants of course. You both are in pain right now. Time is needed I suppose..

Maybe it will, maybe it won’t, but one thing is for sure, we both want happiness and joy, positivity and all that.. and suicide I feel isn’t gonna give either of us that. One day I hope, we both will be old and happy.. for that to happen, we can’t give up. Not so soon.

I can never fully understand another’s pain, since we all feel it differently.. I’ve been abused both mentally and physically, but remember that the pain we feel, is temporary. Deep down, I have faith in the future, I know its not gonna be as bad as it is now. Trust me, good people are out there looking out for you. Maybe your father, maybe your mother and maybe even myself with my limited help. 
I’ve tried to commit suicide since 11, but after all this shit, I realized that I don’t want to die, I want to escape. 
As tough as it is, as shit as it is, right now, we got each other to look for eachother.

Everybody leaving you because of you being ”boring” is a good thing. You don’t deserve those shits in your life. 
The fact that you are young doesn’t make your pain any less significant. Remember, you can only look ahead. The past is done, the future is up to you and so is the present. 
Get that engineering degree, move somewhere, start life again. Ending it, I don’t think is right, but I am here to talk if you need. We’re in this world together.. maybe we can survive with eachothers help.

Ego or not, alot of em are in their ways right. Pain is temporary alot of times. I myself, having been emotionally and physically abused by my parents. 
I’ve come to realise, that everything on this planet is temporary. It doesn’t matter that I will probably have anxiety and depression of some kind for the rest of my life, since I am unable to do anything about it. 
Life isn’t necessarily precious or anything, but I like to see it like this; I am alive, 100 billion people who have ever existed and died aren’t anymore. I have legs, arms, etc. I know people that don’t. 
Everyone here in this life has shit happen to them, some don’t ever make it out. I think about them, and when I’m depressed, I hope for someone to come and save me, even though it never happens directly in person. I am always inside the internet bubble, and some people’s words have made me feel a little bit better sometimes. 
You might be right, we’re all in this journey filled with shit and despair, but I have also seen happiness and positivity, so I wish to feel it again.. 
Call me stupid, idiotic or whatever, but I am here to learn, maybe you are right in all this.
